attchmntText: Schedule of virtual Investor Conference on December 2, 2026.
voiceSummary: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited has intimated the schedule of upcoming Analyst and Institutional Investors meetings. The company will hold a one-on-one meeting with Oaklane Capital in Mumbai on Thursday, November 12, 2026, from 1600 to 1700 Hours IST. Group meetings are scheduled in Mumbai on Monday, November 16, 2026, with CITIC CLSA, and on Tuesday, November 17, 2026, with JM Financial and Avendus. A Singapore investor conference with Morgan Stanley is set for Wednesday, November 18, and Thursday, November 19, 2026, followed by a non-deal roadshow with BofA Securities on Friday, November 20, 2026. Additional engagements include a roadshow in Abu Dhabi and Dubai on Thursday, November 26, and Friday, November 27, 2026, with 360 One Capital Market Pvt Ltd. Virtual and in-person group meetings are planned for December 2, 2026, with Nirmal Bang, and December 9, 2026, with Centrum. The schedule is subject to change, and no unpublished price-sensitive information will be shared.
